title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-024
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA press releases and internal notes regarding reported UFO sightings by commercial flight crews in Alaska between 1985 and 1987.

incidents.summary: Japan Air Lines flight 1628 reported being accompanied by unidentified air traffic from the Alaska-Canadian border to Anchorage.
incidents.explanation: FAA determined a second radar target was a split radar return from the JAL Boeing 747; visual sightings were not confirmed.
incidents.quote: The Nov. 17 UFO sighting was reported by JAL Captain Kenjyu Terauchi
incidents.size: as big as a B747 or larger

incidents.summary: Alaska Airlines flight 53 reported unidentified air traffic on onboard weather radar.
incidents.quote: reported to the FAA Anchorage Air Route Traffic Control Center, the sighting of unidentified air traffic on their onboard weather radar system.

incidents.summary: Captain Kenjyu Terauchi of JAL flight 628 reported seeing unusual lights.
incidents.explanation: FAA concluded phenomena was most likely caused by ice crystals created by a temperature inversion.
incidents.quote: reported to the FAA Air Route Traffic Control Center in Anchorage, that he was seeing a group of unusual lights

incidents.summary: Flying Tigers Flight 73 reported observing a target.
incidents.explanation: Air Force was unable to confirm the sighting.
incidents.quote: reported observing a "target" heading 320 degrees as it approached Anchorage
